title: DeepSeek-Prover-V2: Advancing Formal Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Subgoal Decomposition
paper_type_zh: 前沿形式化推理技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计 Lean 终态验证、子目标分解 RL、形式化语义边界与训练可复现性的读者
one_line: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 combines DeepSeek-V3 proof-sketch decomposition, recursively solved Lean subgoals, Lean-verified cold starts, expert iteration, and GRPO RL, while releasing models and evaluation artifacts but not the core training or audit corpus.
DeepSeek-Prover-V2 将 DeepSeek-V3 证明草图分解、递归求解的 Lean 子目标、Lean 验证冷启动、expert iteration 和 GRPO RL 结合起来；它公开模型和评测工件，但未公开核心训练或审计语料。
why: It makes a frontier formal-RL pipeline legible while separating programmatic proof success from missing source lineage, environment reproducibility, semantic-formalization audit, and data-rights evidence.
inclusion_reason: A frontier formal-reasoning report that discloses recursive subgoal cold starts, Lean-terminal RL, expert iteration, and distillation while leaving core prompts, verifier environment, rollout artifacts, and provenance unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
DeepSeek-Prover-V2 targets formal theorem proving in Lean 4 by combining informal mathematical planning with formal proof generation. Its report is relevant to a reasoning-data audit because it describes synthetic cold starts, self-generated proof data, programmatic proof verification, and reinforcement learning, while the operational artifacts behind those claims remain largely unavailable.

For this Card, a successful Lean check means that a completed proof is accepted for the supplied formal theorem in a particular Lean environment. It does not, on its own, establish the provenance of the theorem prompt, the semantic faithfulness of an autoformalization to an informal source, or reproducibility without the exact environment and data lineage.

DeepSeek-Prover-V2 通过结合非形式化数学规划和 Lean 4 形式化证明生成来解决定理证明问题。它与推理数据审计相关，因为报告描述了合成冷启动、自生成证明数据、程序化证明验证和强化学习，但支撑这些主张的操作性工件大多不可获得。

对本 Card 而言，成功的 Lean 检查意味着一份完成证明在特定 Lean 环境中被给定形式化定理接受。它本身并不能证明定理 prompt 的来源、自动形式化相对非形式化来源的语义忠实性，也不能在缺少精确环境和数据谱系时证明可复现性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central construction starts with DeepSeek-V3. It produces a natural-language proof sketch and a Lean skeleton whose have-style steps contain sorry placeholders. A 7B prover recursively resolves the resulting subgoals; when every subgoal is solved, their proofs are composed into a proof of the original theorem and appended to the DeepSeek-V3 reasoning trace as synthetic cold-start data.

The feedback contract is programmatic and terminal. GRPO samples candidate completed proofs and gives a binary reward of one to Lean-verified proofs and zero otherwise. Early RL adds a structural consistency reward that penalizes generated proofs which diverge from the proposed decomposition. This is not a released interactive verifier service, and its exact configuration is not disclosed.

核心构建从 DeepSeek-V3 开始。它生成一份非形式化证明草图，以及一份其 have 式步骤带有 sorry 占位符的 Lean 骨架。7B prover 递归求解得到的子目标；当全部子目标均被解决时，子证明会被组合成原始定理的证明，并附加到 DeepSeek-V3 推理轨迹中，形成合成冷启动数据。

反馈契约是程序化且终态的。GRPO 对候选完成证明进行采样，并向经 Lean 验证的证明赋予一、否则赋予零的二值奖励。早期 RL 另加结构一致性奖励，惩罚偏离建议分解的生成证明。这不是已发布的交互式验证服务，其精确配置也未披露。

title: Method
方法
html:
DeepSeek-V3 first analyzes a formal theorem in natural language, decomposes it into proof steps, and formalizes the steps as Lean statements. The 7B prover turns each extracted subgoal into a locally solvable lemma, optionally carrying earlier subgoals as premises. Two subgoal-theorem variants enter a curriculum, and a successful set of subgoal proofs is composed into a complete proof.

Cold-start examples are restricted to difficult problems that the 7B prover cannot solve end-to-end but whose decomposed subgoals it can solve. The complete Lean proof is paired with the DeepSeek-V3 chain-of-thought. In non-CoT expert iteration, a current best policy attempts unsolved hard problems; Lean-verified successes are added to SFT. The paper additionally states that autoformalized and unspecified open-source problems broaden the training distribution, and that miniF2F-valid is augmented with decomposed subgoal problems.

For the 671B model, SFT on DeepSeek-V3-Base-671B uses a 16,384-token context and constant 5e-6 learning rate. GRPO then samples 256 theorem prompts per iteration, 32 candidate proofs per theorem, and up to 32,768 tokens; its reward is binary Lean correctness plus an early decomposition-consistency signal. The 7B model extends DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-Base to 32K, distills 671B RL rollouts with non-CoT proof data, and receives another RL stage. Prompt text, source manifests, rollout records, temperatures, full optimizer/KL settings, and yields are unavailable.

DeepSeek-V3 先以自然语言分析形式化定理，将其分解为证明步骤，并把步骤形式化为 Lean 陈述。7B prover 将每个提取出的子目标转化为局部可解的 lemma，并可把先前子目标作为前提携带。两种子目标定理变体进入 curriculum，成功的一组子目标证明被组合为完整证明。

冷启动示例仅保留这样的难题：7B prover 不能端到端解决，但可以解决其全部分解子目标。完整 Lean 证明与 DeepSeek-V3 CoT 配对。在非 CoT expert iteration 中，当前最佳策略尝试此前未解的难题；经 Lean 验证的成功样本被加入 SFT。论文还称，自动形式化问题和未指明的开源问题会拓宽训练分布，miniF2F-valid 会用分解子目标问题进行扩增。

对 671B 模型，DeepSeek-V3-Base-671B 上的 SFT 使用 16,384 token 上下文和恒定的 5e-6 学习率。随后 GRPO 每轮采样 256 个定理 prompt、每个定理 32 个候选证明、最大 32,768 token；其奖励是 Lean 二值正确性加早期分解一致性信号。7B 模型将 DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-Base 扩展到 32K，以 671B RL rollout 和非 CoT 证明数据蒸馏，并接受另一阶段 RL。prompt 文本、来源清单、rollout 记录、温度、完整 optimizer/KL 设置和产出率均不可获得。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv record identifies the 2025 report and documents DeepSeek-V3 decomposition, 7B recursive proof search, synthetic cold starts, binary reward supervision, and the reported training settings. It reports miniF2F-test only for evaluation, while miniF2F-valid is used in the subgoal curriculum.

The official DeepSeek-Prover-V2 repository provides the report, README, model license, figures, and a miniF2F-solution ZIP. It links official 7B/671B model downloads and DeepSeek-ProverBench, a 325-problem formalized evaluation dataset. The official 671B model page provides model-release material.

These sources verify models and evaluation artifacts, not a release of the training prompts, DeepSeek-V3 outputs, subgoal trees, SFT records, GRPO rollouts, reward logs, rejected attempts, exact Lean environment, or item-level provenance.

官方 arXiv 记录 标识了这份 2025 报告，并记录 DeepSeek-V3 分解、7B 递归证明搜索、合成冷启动、二值奖励监督和所报告的训练设置。它说明 miniF2F-test 仅用于评估，而 miniF2F-valid 用于子目标 curriculum。

官方 DeepSeek-Prover-V2 仓库 提供报告、README、模型许可证、图表和 miniF2F 解答 ZIP；它链接官方 7B/671B 模型下载及 DeepSeek-ProverBench，后者是含 325 道形式化问题的评测数据集。官方 671B 模型页 提供模型发布材料。

这些来源验证了模型和评测工件，而不是训练 prompt、DeepSeek-V3 输出、子目标树、SFT 记录、GRPO rollout、奖励日志、拒绝尝试、精确 Lean 环境或条目级来源谱系的发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For Track 12, the notable feature is a disclosed interface between informal decomposition and formal terminal verification. The paper separates a large-model planner from a smaller recursive prover, uses solved subgoals both as cold-start material and curriculum variants, and adds a reward that encourages the generated final proof to preserve the planned lemma structure.

The disclosure remains recipe-level. It specifies several operational counts and model roles, but does not release the prompt corpus, decomposition trees, proof attempts, reward records, or the environment needed to reproduce a Lean verdict. That makes the work a frontier-report disclosure record rather than a reproducible training release.

对 Track 12 而言，显著之处是它披露了非形式化分解与形式化终态验证之间的接口。论文将大模型规划器和较小的递归 prover 分开，既把已解子目标用于冷启动材料，也把它们作为 curriculum 变体，并加入奖励以鼓励生成的最终证明保留计划中的 lemma 结构。

披露仍停留在配方层。它规定了一些操作性数量和模型角色，却未发布 prompt 语料、分解树、证明尝试、奖励记录或重现 Lean 判定所需的环境。因此，这项工作是前沿报告披露记录，而不是可复现训练发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The core construction artifacts are unreleased: source and prompt manifests, full DeepSeek-V3 decomposition outputs, subgoal dependency trees, cold-start records, expert-iteration traces, GRPO rollouts, rewards, accepted/rejected attempts, and distillation samples. The repository contains release material and a solution archive, not executable data-construction, training, RL, or environment code.

Lean terminal verification is strong for the supplied formal theorem only under its exact environment. The paper reports Lean 4.9.0-rc2 for evaluation, but does not fully pin the training environment, mathlib snapshot, imports, or invocation. A Lean-successful proof therefore does not itself establish source provenance, benchmark separation beyond the reported test/valid boundary, or semantic faithfulness when a natural-language problem was autoformalized. No released decontamination protocol or overlap analysis resolves leakage risk.

The official model release is governed by the DeepSeek License Agreement, not MIT. That license does not grant rights to the training data, whose source, annotation, synthetic-trace, and derivative-data terms remain unknown.

核心构建工件未发布：来源和 prompt 清单、完整 DeepSeek-V3 分解输出、子目标依赖树、冷启动记录、expert-iteration 轨迹、GRPO rollout、奖励、已接受/拒绝尝试以及蒸馏样本。仓库包含发布材料和解答档案，而不是可执行的数据构建、训练、RL 或环境代码。

Lean 终态验证仅在其精确环境中对给定形式化定理具有强约束。论文报告评测使用 Lean 4.9.0-rc2，却没有完整锁定训练环境、mathlib snapshot、imports 或调用方式。因此，Lean 成功证明本身并不建立来源谱系、除已报告 test/valid 边界外的基准隔离，也不保证自然语言问题被自动形式化后的语义忠实性。未发布的去污染协议或重叠分析无法解除泄漏风险。

官方模型发布受 DeepSeek License Agreement 约束，而非 MIT。该许可不授予训练数据权利；训练数据的来源、标注、合成轨迹和衍生数据条款仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit a formal-RL claim without treating a model-weight release as an end-to-end data release. It distinguishes three review questions: whether a candidate proof passes the terminal Lean predicate, whether the theorem being proved faithfully represents its source problem, and whether the data and environment make the reported pipeline reproducible.

The report can inform conceptual comparisons of synthetic cold starts, subgoal curricula, expert iteration, formal proof SFT, GRPO, and rollout distillation. It is not a reusable release of the core training data, verifier environment, reward implementation, or complete provenance record.

可使用本 Card 审计形式化 RL 主张，而不会把模型权重发布视为端到端数据发布。它区分三个审查问题：候选证明是否通过 Lean 终态条件、被证明的定理是否忠实表达其来源问题，以及数据和环境是否使所报告管线可复现。

该报告可用于概念层面对合成冷启动、子目标 curriculum、expert iteration、形式化证明 SFT、GRPO 和 rollout 蒸馏进行比较。它不是核心训练数据、验证环境、奖励实现或完整来源记录的可复用发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read cold-start construction and RL together: binary Lean reward follows a selective pipeline in which only particular solved subgoal decompositions become training examples.
  • Separate proof verification from theorem provenance and semantics. Lean checks the supplied formal statement under a specific environment; it does not audit an upstream autoformalization or source license.
  • Treat public models, ProverBench, and miniF2F solution files as release facts, not substitutes for prompts, rollouts, reward logs, environment pins, split manifests, or decontamination evidence.

• 应把冷启动构建和 RL 一起阅读：二值 Lean 奖励位于一条选择性管线之后，只有特定的已解子目标分解才会成为训练示例。
  • 应把证明验证与定理来源和语义分开。Lean 在特定环境下检查给定的形式化陈述；它不审计上游自动形式化或来源许可证。
  • 应将公开模型、ProverBench 和 miniF2F 解答文件视为发布事实，而不是 prompt、rollout、奖励日志、环境版本锁定、划分清单或去污染证据的替代品。
